text:
IncidentBot: P1 ALERT — embeddings-service error_rate spike in us-east-1 (>5% over 2m). Page sent to @Alex. Incident ID: INC-2026-EMBEDS-82 :rotating_light:

Alex: ack. I'm primary. Brief: recent deploy at 13:02 UTC correlated with rise in 504s and increased latency on streaming embedding endpoints. Impacting embeddings.generate_v2 route.

Maya: I'm secondary, standby to take over or flip routing.

Alex: Quick triage steps I'm running now:
```
# health
curl -sS https://internal-embeds.us-east-1.internal/health | jq .
# tail recent errors
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embeddings --since=5m | grep -i error | tail -n 50
```

Alex: Log snippet:
```
2026-04-12T13:18:05Z ERROR request_id=abc123 kv_cache/miss latency_ms=9300 model=embed-large reason="kv cache pressure"
2026-04-12T13:18:07Z WARN  request_id=def456 grpc: upstream closed stream
```

Jon: infra note — autoscaler didn't spin up additional GPU nodes after the deploy. I'm doing a manual scale now (requested +2 p4d nodes). ETA ~8m. If that doesn't land, we'll failover to dedicated fallback cluster.

Emma: Customer impact: Support reports AcmeCorp and Buildly seeing 10-15s tails and occasional 504s. Ticket numbers: SUP-5142, SUP-5147. Drafting a status update to customers now.

Alex: Immediate mitigations in progress:
- Enable fallback routing to `embed-lite-v2` for non-enterprise traffic (console: <https://redwood.internal/console/routing>).
- Disable large-batch inference on embeddings.generate_v2 to reduce memory pressure.
- Increase KV cache eviction aggressiveness (runtime flag) to prevent stalls.
- Manual pool scale (Jon is on it).

Alex: Runbook pointers:
- Inc runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-failure|runbook: embeddings-failure>
- Fallback routing doc: <https://redwood.internal/docs/fallback-routing>

Maya: I'll watch metrics and alerts: error_rate, 95p latency, queue_depth. Thresholds to escalate to Jon: error_rate >10% OR 95p latency >5s for 5m.

Alex: Handoff notes for overnight shift:
- Active alerts: embeddings-service/ERR_RATE (P1), embeddings-service/POOL_UTIL (P2)
- Mitigations applied: fallback routing enabled for 80% of traffic (non-enterprise), large-batch disabled, manual scale requested (pending).
- Customer impact: two enterprise customers with degraded latency (support notified). No customer data leak — only latency/errors.
- Known gaps: No dedicated secondary between 02:00–04:00 UTC tomorrow due to rotation overlap. Maya, can you cover 02:00–04:00 or arrange backup?

Maya: I can cover 02:00–03:30 UTC but need someone for the 03:30–04:00 slot. Priya, can you take 03:30–04:00?

Priya: yeah I can take 03:30–04:15 UTC. I will be reachable by phone if paging hits.

Alex: Escalation path if mitigations fail:
1) Call Jon (infra lead) -> pager listed in runbook
2) Escalate to Eng manager + Cx leads for customer comms
3) Consider enable read-only fallback (severe) and rate-limiting for public traffic

Alex: I'm stepping out for a quick break at 16:30 PDT — handing active primary to Maya. I'll keep Slack notifications on. Please ping me directly for any rollback decisions.

Maya: ack, taking primary at 16:30 PDT. I'll post updates in this thread and update the incident doc.

IncidentBot: Note: alert auto-escalation set to 10m. Current metrics snapshot: error_rate 6.3% | 95p latency 4.2s | pool_util 87%.

Alex: Thanks team. I'll add a short postmortem checklist in the incident doc once stabilised. :thumbsup:

Maya: Will monitor and follow up. /me re-checks dashboard every 2m.
